scope: Local runs/*/config.json census, including earlier K1, with exact recorded integers and conservative one-million-offset native uint32 seed/root reservations. No ledger, bulk data, unavailable external run or unrecorded-reset audit; no global freshness guarantee.

known_reset_ledgers.scope: Exact integer census of readable saved *ledger*.json/jsonl under runs, artifacts, results and archive; frozen source copies excluded. Candidate files under explicit synthetic fixture roots named test_evidence or pytest_tmp are excluded from reset evidence and retained separately with hashes and byte counts. Unknown, external and unrecorded resets are outside this proof.
